scripts.tauri:dev: pnpm build:tauri:web && node scripts/run-in-vsdevcmd.mjs -- cargo tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm build:tauri:web && node scripts/run-in-vsdevcmd.mjs -- cargo tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:mac: pnpm build:tauri:web && node scripts/run-in-vsdevcmd.mjs -- cargo tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles app,dmg
scripts.tauri:build:windows:x64: pnpm build:tauri:web && node scripts/run-in-vsdevcmd.mjs --arch x64 --host-arch x64 -- cargo tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles nsis --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.tauri:build:windows:arm64: pnpm build:tauri:web && node scripts/run-in-vsdevcmd.mjs --arch arm64 --host-arch x64 -- cargo tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles nsis --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
